ambiguities.details: Blessed Wind chain prose and Blessed Whirl macro naming retained without equating ability identities. Critical guarantees are contributor claims only.
Almost perfectly explicitly qualifies mentoring downrank behavior; no universal correctness inferred.

Location and Mob labels do not prove drops, spawn coordinates or quest rewards. Blank Mob labels remain null; Griffon questline is not classified as a creature. EPIC heading does not establish item soul-slot fields.

limitations: Archived undated contributor advice is not independent corroboration or verified mechanics.
Macros preserved without executing commands; item and ability names do not establish canonical IDs.
